remarks: This is rare rental opportunity in one of Westport's most sought-after neighborhoods. Perfectly situated on a quiet residential street ideal for walking and biking, offering the perfect combination of comfort, space, and convenience all just minutes from downtown, beaches, parks, galleries and top-rated schools.This beautifully maintained, newly renovated 5 bed, 3 full bath raised-ranch features a bright & functional layout with spacious living areas, generously sized bedrooms, and a finished walk-out lower level offering flexible living space ideal for a recreation room, home office or guest area. There's abundant storage both inside & out. Enjoy seamless access to a peaceful and private backyard retreat complete with a beautiful patio, deck areas attached to home and beyond fence area. Perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Location is everything! Downtown-5 min.;Train station-11 min ; Compo Beach and Sherwood Island Beaches 7-11 min; Public Golf and sailing facilities -11 min; I-95 and Merritt Parkway- 5-10 minutes;Staples High 4 min.,Bedford Middle 4 min.,Long Lots Elem 6 min; Entertainment centers, shopping, dining, fitness, and recreational amenities - all within minutes! You just can't beat it! Enjoy the very best of Westport living in a neighborhood and home you truly won't want to leave. PACK YOUR BAGS & MOVE IN SOON! Applicants must apply through RentSpree for credit, background, & rental history verification. Ask agent for link. Professional Photographs coming soon
